mapper.sql: id, country_code, country_name, country_name_zh, country_aliases, timezone, timezones, currency_code, currency_name, currency_symbol, is_common

choose.when: ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(country_code) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 0 WHEN country_name_zh = #{keyword} THEN 1 WHEN country_name = #{keyword} THEN 2 WHEN country_aliases = #{keyword} OR CONCAT(',', IFNULL(country_aliases, ''), ',') LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{keyword}, ',%') THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, is_common DESC, country_name_zh ASC, country_code ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY is_common DESC, country_name_zh ASC, country_code ASC

mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_country_ref WHERE UPPER(country_code) = UPPER(#{countryCode}) LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM t_country_ref ORDER BY is_common DESC, country_name_zh ASC, country_code ASC
